description: This file defines a utility object 'SplitUtils' that provides string splitting functionality, returning a linked list of tokens obtained by splitting the input string on spaces.

classes.name: SplitUtils
classes.description: A utility object for splitting strings into tokens based on spaces and storing them in a linked list.

methods.name: split
methods.description: Splits a source string into tokens based on spaces, returning a linked list of valid tokens.

methods.name: addIfValid
methods.description: Adds the token to the list if it is valid (not empty).

methods.name: isTokenValid
methods.description: Checks whether a token is valid, i.e., non-empty.
